full_judgment:
14. Dr SM Bulbul (PW 8) stated that Shahida Chowdhury is his wife, that Shahida Chowdhury died in the CMH on 15-10-93, that till her death she was his wife, that on 8-8-93 he took his wife to Dhaka for delivery and came to the residence of Rezaul Karim, that Shahida gave birth to a baby by a caesarean operation at Memory Medical Centre on 28-8-93, that she was released from the medical centre on 23-8-93, that she stayed there for about one week after delivery of the baby, that on 8-10-93 he knew about the stabbing of his wife through Professor Ali Akbor, that thereafter Rezaul's wife Beauty intimated the news over telephone and the news of shifting her to CMH for treatment and the detention of Liaqat, that on the following day he came to the hospital, that as per advice of the doctor he put his signature on some papers. In cross-examination he admitted that he has not stated to the police that he was leading conjugal life with his wife since 15th October, 1993. He denied the defence suggestion that he did not state to the police that he took his wife on 8-3-93 for caesarean delivery, then he said that he could not remember the same. He admitted that he did not take his wife to the Memory Medical Centre and that his wife gave birth to a baby by caesarean operation. He denied the defence suggestion that his sister-in-law intimated him about the incident over telephone that Liaqat stabbed Shahida Chowdhury. He denied the defence suggestion that he divorced his wife on 19-8-92 or that Shahida married Liaqat on 31-12-92 or that they led conjugal life or that at the time of his marriage he was 50 years old or that Shahida was 20 years or that their conjugal life was not cordial. He admitted that Liaqat's mother instituted Family Suit No.158 of 1994 in the Family Court at Dhaka for custody of Shahida's baby and that he contested that suit. He expressed his ignorance whether the said suit was decreed ex parte on 28-7-97. He denied the defence suggestion that Shahida was the legally married wife of Liaqat from 31-12-92 to 15-10-93. 

 28. The defence claimed that deceased Shahida was the legally married wife of the convict Liaqat and that in the said marriage the deceased gave birth to a female baby. On the other hand, prosecution claimed that Shahida was the wife of PW 8 Dr SM Bulbul and that in the said wedlock the baby was born. This witness claimed that he led conjugal life with Shahida since 19-9-82 to 15th October, 1993. PWs 3-5 made similar statement and denied the defence suggestion that Liaqat Ali Khan married Shahida on 31-12-92 and that in the said marriage, they were blessed with a baby. Though the PWs 3-5 and 8 have denied the defence version but from the admission of PW 8 in course of cross-examination, we find the probability of this defence version. PW 8 admitted that after the death of Shahida, Liaqat Ali Khan's mother instituted Family Suit No.158/94 in the 2nd Court of Assistant Judge for custody of the baby. He further admitted that though he contested the suit initially but subsequently the suit was decreed. This proved that Liaqat Ali Khan's mother got the decree for the custody of the baby of Shahida. This admission indicated that the baby was born in the wedlock of the marriage between Shahida and Liaqat Ali Khan, otherwise PW 8 would not have allowed Liaqat Ali Khan's mother to take the custody of the baby from the Family Court. The learned Additional Metropolitan Sessions Judge was not justified in disbelieving this defence version, inasmuch as; the defence was not required to prove anything by adducing any evidence. If from the lips of the prosecution witnesses, the defence brings something in its favour, the court can draw an inference in its favour. Even if it is assumed that Shahida Chowdhury was the legally married wife of Liaqat he could not absolve with the responsibility of her death for the reasons discussed above. In that view of the matter, we fully agree with the learned Additional Metropolitan Sessions Judge that the prosecution has been able to prove that the convict Liaqat was responsible for the cause of death of Shahida Chowdhury.
